plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid cell opposite its current orientation without changing that orientation, while reusing the existing boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to the supported MovementOrder values.
Add a position operation that calculates the adjacent cell opposite a supplied orientation.
Handle REVERSE when MovementEngine determines vehicle intentions, preserving orientation and allowing the existing board validation and conflict-resolution phases to block invalid reverse movements.
Document reverse vectors, unchanged orientation, board-boundary behavior, and applicability of the existing collision rules; remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Add movement-engine coverage showing reverse movement for NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, and WEST orientations and verifying orientation remains unchanged.
Verify reverse movement is blocked when its target lies outside the board.
Verify reverse orders participate in existing collision behavior, including occupied targets, shared targets, swaps, and movement into successfully vacated cells.
Run the backend test suite with ./mvnw test from the backend directory.
